description: Flag catch blocks that log the error but then silently continue with bad/default state instead of re-throwing or returning an error result.
Verify errors include context (entity ID, operation name) for debugging.
Flag god services that handle multiple unrelated domains - split into focused services.
Flag duplicated business logic across services - shared behavior belongs in extracted functions.

Flag duplicated business-critical source-of-truth values, lists, mappings, state transitions, permission maps, endpoint or query keys, schema-contract mappings, or pure helper logic when divergence would change behavior. SKIP duplicated visual class strings, JSX markup, local table alignment classes, and presentational component composition.

Flag duplicated visual class strings, JSX markup, local table alignment classes, status badge markup, or presentational component composition only when the duplication appears across reusable or shared UI surfaces or across 2+ files and extraction would reduce drift. SKIP one-off route-level or local markup duplication. Do not flag as critical unless divergence changes business behavior.
Using router navigation to update UI state that should be local. Navigation is for page transitions, not for form inputs, filter toggles, or multi-selects.

Route files (`src/routes/**/*.tsx`) that define `useQuery` or `useInfiniteQuery` calls with inline `queryKey` and `queryFn` instead of importing from a query factory (`src/features/<domain>/api/queries.ts`). Query factories co-locate keys, functions, and options for reuse and cache invalidation.
Route files with `useMutation` calls containing complex `mutationFn` logic (>10 lines of request shaping, multipart handling, or error mapping). Extract to `src/features/<domain>/api/mutations.ts`.
Same endpoint call (identical path + method + schema) defined inline in 2+ files instead of a shared query factory. Each copy drifts independently when the contract changes.

Flag multi-step solutions that reimplement built-in APIs in business logic, data flow, async control flow, routing, state management, or framework integration when the extra machinery creates correctness risk. Reviewer must name the simpler approach. SKIP local UI class composition and presentational prop ergonomics.
Flag local UI or styling code that adds custom props or helpers where CSS selectors, built-in variants, or existing component props solve the same problem more simply.
Flag access to private framework properties (prefixed `__`, `_react`, `_fiber`, `__internals`). Must use the public API or expose state via window for test hooks.
Flag code that reconstructs what the framework already tracks (shadow state lists, re-implementing routing, re-implementing state management).
Flag `as unknown as X` double casts and `as any` used to bypass a type error rather than fix the root cause. Require a comment justifying why the type system cannot express the constraint.
Flag manual DOM/fiber/tree traversal (while-parent, recursive node walking) when a standard query API (querySelector, closest, refs) or exposed test hook solves the problem.
Flag code whose correctness depends on undocumented implementation details of a library (internal field names, non-public event names, array index assumptions).
Every public type and schema in `packages/contracts/` must be re-exported from `src/index.ts`. Flag new exports in subdirectories that are missing from the barrel.

New exports added to `packages/db/src/index.ts` must also be added to `src/core.ts` (unless NestJS-specific like `DatabaseModule`). The `core.ts` barrel is used by CLI scripts that run via tsx/esbuild and cannot handle NestJS decorators.
